questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding Foreign Service under FR 110-127:
I. A government servant cannot be transferred to foreign service against their will.
II. While on foreign service, the government servant remains subject to the disciplinary rules of the borrowing organization exclusively.
III. Leave salary and pension contributions must be paid to the government by either the foreign employer or the government servant.
IV. A government servant on foreign service retains their lien in the parent department.
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Transfer to foreign service requires the consent of the government servant. While on foreign service, the employee retains a lien on their parent cadre post, and leave salary and pension contributions are payable to government. Disciplinary control remains with the parent department, although the borrowing organization can initiate preliminary inquiry proceedings.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। विदेशी सेवा में स्थानांतरण के लिए सरकारी कर्मचारी की सहमति आवश्यक है। विदेशी सेवा के दौरान, कर्मचारी अपने मूल श्रेणी पद पर लीन बनाए रखता है, और छुट्टी वेतन और पेंशन योगदान सरकार को देय होते हैं। अनुशासनात्मक नियंत्रण मूल विभाग के पास रहता है, हालांकि उधार लेने वाली संस्था प्रारंभिक जांच की प्रक्रिया शुरू कर सकती है।
